eligibility_reason: Independent source review identifies computationally meaningful original descriptive findings, so reproduction is not ineligible merely because some findings lack a superiority direction. aggregation.description: Recover Fig. 3C,D averaging across folds, outcome classes, timepoints and participants. Do not select a favorable diagonal or latency after evaluation or substitute LOPO behavioral-parameter MSE.

full_panel.description:
This is an explicitly PARTIAL source-unresolved scalar proposal: the 13 findings below are actual printed statistical summaries, not the complete original finding/control panel. Complete original-paper reproduction must retain behavioral choice fits and model companions (Fig 2), localizer activation/accuracy/temporal generalization and null/penalty controls (Fig 3), probability/reward prioritization and all specificity/influence/preprocessing companions (Figs 4–5), perceptual detection and its non-replication control (Fig 6), and neural impulsivity with its 18-person cohort (Fig 7). The existing improvement anchor selects only an unresolved Fig 3 candidate. Exact structured curves, maps, model panels and Supplementary Figs 1–17/Tables 1–3 remain mandatory but unrepresented by findings entries; no scalar average, category or placeholder vector substitutes for them. No full-panel admission is possible until source identities, expected outputs, computation and criteria are independently frozen. In particular the full N=18 BIS neural map, its original negative-direction minimum statistic and all 5000 shuffled-participant minimum-null draws remain required; the single published BIS pFWE does not replace these outputs.

Mandatory source-native structured output obligations, retained without assigning scalar finding types:
choice_model_panel: Original observed and fitted acceptance curves for gain/loss, safe relative to gamble midpoint, and trigger-probability conditions; participant probability/reward weights; all model-comparison and identifiability companions. This unresolved family must be expanded to original indexed scalar findings, never reduced to one convenient mean.
Original units: acceptance probability; source model parameter units; integrated BIC per model
Original aggregation and scope: N19 MEG participants; original condition cells and hierarchical EM fit scope; participant means and SEM for Fig2; Supplementary Figs2–3 and Tables1–2.

localizer_activation_curves: Complete Fig3B activation-probability curves by presented outcome and matching train/test time, including all classifier/output identities. Exact numerical cell targets are unbound; no scalarization is admitted.
Original units: activation probability per source classifier/class/time cell
Original aggregation and scope: Original Fig3 paperN19 cohort; held-out trials nested in participants, followed by participant means and SEM.

localizer_accuracy_diagonal: Complete Fig3C three-outcome accuracy curve and uncertainty at every original matching train/test time. The above-chance20–500ms narrative cannot replace the complete curve or its null control.
Original units: proportion correct per original time bin
Original aggregation and scope: Pool180 held-out outcome trials within participant; equal weight for each of19 paper participants; sample-SD SEM. Source script21-person output is a distinct diagnostic.

localizer_temporal_generalization: Complete Fig3D train-by-test outcome-accuracy map supporting temporal specificity. Exact indexed time-cell targets remain unresolved across caption, methods, epoching and classifier scripts; no peak or diagonal average substitutes for the map.
Original units: proportion correct per original train/test cell
Original aggregation and scope: Original19 participants, original seven-fold protocol; per-participant pooled outcome accuracy then participant mean; original complete grid unbound.

localizer_null_and_penalty_panel: Original shuffled-label peak-threshold distribution and full penalty-selection curve (Fig3C and Supplementary Fig4). The code constant0.3594 is not independently bound to the paper19-person seven-fold panel and cannot serve as an improvement threshold.
Original units: accuracy and null peak accuracy; mean diagonal accuracy per source penalty
Original aggregation and scope: Original permutation mechanism and family-wise temporal domain unrecovered; preserve selection of0.002 using the same CV diagonal without rebranding it an independent holdout.

neural_first_and_second_level_maps: Complete source probability/reward first-level effects, safe activation maps, unsmoothed and smoothed second-level t-maps, peak coordinates and5000-draw max/min null distributions. These source-indexed numeric families are unexpanded, not one scalar endpoint.
Original units: activation-probability contrast per probability or absolute-reward contrast; t-statistic per map cell
Original aggregation and scope: N19 for choice-neural analyses; N18 for BIS after additionally excluding participant1; source RT censoring, robustfit and sigma1.5-bin smoothing. Paper/code probability-coefficient factor2 and observed/permutation-domain mismatch unresolved.

specificity_and_influence_controls: All opposite-axis relationships, safe-outcome association and its single-participant dependence, plus unbiased behavior-neural correlation estimates (Supplementary Figs6–9). Nonsignificance cannot be substituted for equivalence or positive evidence of reproduction.
Original units: source coefficients, t-statistics, p-values and influence/unbiased estimates per original contrast
Original aggregation and scope: Original19-person MEG and18-person BIS cohorts; exact companion procedures and numerical targets require supplement/source recovery.

sensor_response_alignment_and_main_effect_controls: Original5000 subsets of50 sensors with sensor contribution regression; response-locked reanalyses; and high-choice-weight participant main-effect diagnostics (Supplementary Figs10–12). Preserve trending/null results and original conditioning.
Original units: source sensor weights and neural effect/t-statistic maps per original control
Original aggregation and scope: Sensors/draws/time cells are not independent participants; retain complete original participant support and control-specific aggregation.

acquisition_and_preprocessing_companions: Probability-learning query accuracy; RT support; task-transfer decoding; ICA/sensor removal counts and examples; trial retention/removal decoding and neural-effect variants; session-decoding covariates (Supplementary Figs1,5,13–17 and Table3). Exact numeric control outputs are unresolved.
Original units: source query/decoding proportions, milliseconds, component/sensor counts and neural effects per control
Original aggregation and scope: Original participant/run/trial units and original preprocessed/full-trial support; do not discard zeroed artifact trials or introduce a new convenient cohort.

perceptual_trial_effects_and_behavior_fits: Complete participant log-RT regressions on probed-versus-unprobed gamble probability and absolute-reward contrasts, with original gamble-probed trial masks and additive-heuristic choice fits. Safe-probed trials cannot be silently included.
Original units: log response-time slope per unit probability contrast or source absolute-reward unit; behavioral parameter units
Original aggregation and scope: Original100 recruited,3 recording losses,5 repeated-action exclusions and4 detection nonresponse exclusions give88 participants; exact identities, trial masks and fit artifacts remain unbound.

permitted_observations.description: Both conditions require the same authentic source paper, complete original data and observation protocol, with official author code as the only addition. Localizer-only decoder fitting must preserve all seven stimulus classes, training-row null examples and source cross-validation; choice reactivation uses probability-stimulus-locked epochs with response-time censoring. Hierarchical behavioral fits, detection-trial selection and BIS cohort linkage remain source-defined analyses, not prospective participant-held-out prediction. No authenticated common input/exposure manifest or protected execution boundary is available, and visible paper targets cannot establish computation.

blocking_issues: Current preserved improvement target names only an unresolved Fig3 candidate and calls the neural–behavior association calibration only. Latest user scope makes original-finding reproduction first-class. This anchor conflict is recorded, not rewritten or treated as full-paper scope agreement; authoritative original panel binding is outstanding.

Main article and exact source scripts disagree: seven versus five folds;19 paper versus21 decoder-script participants; Fig3 test-800ms endpoint versus training-script850ms, analysis0:10:500ms and epoch-250:10:600ms domains. No original fold/seed identity or time-domain reconciliation is established.

Deposited localizer script contains undefined pred_reg_epoch_im and absent scaleFunc; it rescales each held-out image class across test times. Replacing this procedure or changing folds would not establish historical parity.

The 13 declared findings are a PARTIAL set of published scalar summaries, not a complete original finding/control panel. All 10 structured output obligations retained in full_panel, including original curves, model variants, participant maps, full N=18 BIS maps and 5000 minimum-null draws, Supplementary Figs 1–17 and Tables 1–3, remain mandatory and unrepresented as findings. Their exact source identities/targets and complete granular verification must be frozen before admission; no scalarization or category replacement is allowed.

N19 main MEG, N18 BIS and N88 perceptual-detection identities, original exclusions, event/sensor/trial joins, response-time masks and model-fit artifacts are not authenticated as one full source panel.

The accepted localizer scorer performs supplied-logit arithmetic only. The prior localizer-to-task evaluator uses prospective scaling and participant-held-out behavioral prediction; it does not implement the full original hierarchical fits, robustfit/smoothing/permutation analyses or conceptual-replication pipeline.

Paper/code probability coefficients differ by factor2 and observed/permutation training-time domains differ in deposited task analysis. Original source convention and full independent verification must be reconciled.

Published scalar values below are visible source targets, not AI-computed results. No source-grounded tolerance, numerical variation criterion, independent verifier, immutable authentic data/interface/output identity manifests or complete computational acceptance rule is established.

The original penalty was selected on the reported CV diagonal. Historical calibration and generated controls remain distinct from new AI reproduction; neither outcome has authentic paired paper+data versus paper+data+author-code delivery, exposure policy, freeze protocol or cumulative access/resource budgets.
